description: This file defines the LocationCurrentRequest enum with a static method to resolve the current location asynchronously, utilizing CLLocationManager and handling caching, accuracy, and timeout features.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the current location, either returning a cached location if within maxAgeMs, or requesting a new one with specified accuracy, timeout, and request closure.

methods.name: accuracyValue
methods.description: Converts an OpenClawLocationAccuracy enum value to a corresponding CLLocationAccuracy constant.
